# Web Highlighter Pro

> Local-first Chrome research clipper for saving webpage quotes, collecting source-backed research notes, searching highlights by website, and exporting notes as TXT or Markdown.

Website: https://kjyang0114.dev/web-highlighter-pro/
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/web-highlighter-pro/pkonbcipepfffbjcogkkepneeobogdjl
Checkout: https://kjyang.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/2e3daee2-efb1-4c5e-b265-407b7bb25bb0
Support: support@kjyang0114.dev

## Summary

Web Highlighter Pro helps students, researchers, writers, founders, and PKM users collect useful quotes while browsing. Users select text on a webpage, use the right-click context menu to save it, then review saved research highlights from the Chrome extension popup.

Primary positioning:

- Local-first research clipper for Chrome
- Chrome extension for saving webpage quotes
- Markdown web clipper for research notes
- Web highlighter with source URLs and Markdown export
- Local-first note capture tool for students, writers, researchers, and PKM users

## Main Features

- Highlight selected text on webpages
- Save quote text, source URL, page title, and timestamp locally
- Search saved research highlights
- Filter notes by source website
- Export source-backed notes as TXT or Markdown
- Open original source pages from saved notes
- Free trial with 5 highlights
- Lifetime Pro unlock through Lemon Squeezy license key

## Privacy

Notes are stored locally in Chrome using chrome.storage.local. Web Highlighter Pro does not run its own backend notes database and does not require an account.

## Pricing

Lifetime license: US$19.99
Early bird code: G1OTY4NW for 20% off

## Best Fit Users

- Students collecting study notes
- Researchers saving source passages
- Writers collecting references
- Founders and operators reading product or market research
- PKM users who want Markdown export

## Use Cases

- Export webpage highlights to Markdown
- Save webpage quotes with source URLs
- Collect research notes while browsing
- Build a quote library for essays, articles, and market research
- Move browser highlights into Obsidian, Notion, Logseq, Bear, Google Docs, or any Markdown workflow
- Keep lightweight local notes without creating another account
